title: Ofgem publishes the energy price cap for 1 April to 30 June 2027 — the step that prices domestic electricity back at 5% VAT, and the only cap announcement on this calendar carrying a mechanical tax snap-back
source: EST: ofgem.gov.uk/news/changes-energy-price-cap-between-1-october-and-31-december-2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — Ofgem's own 26 August 2026 cap release, under 'Energy price cap level dates', reads verbatim 'The levels for the next periods will be announced by: ... 23 February 2027 - period 1 April 2027 to 30 June 2027'. The word is 'by', and Ofgem states the discretion on its sibling pages ('We may publish before this date if we need to because of external reasons'), so the specific day is a reasoning estimate on top of a fetched primary — which is what EST: means. The deadline has been beaten once in three sourced cycles (by 25 Nov 2025 resolved 21 Nov 2025; by 25 Feb 2026 and by 26 Aug 2026 both resolved on the day). Also estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a UK sector regulator. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of ofgem-price-cap-announcement-2026-11-25
notes: PROPOSED BY THE ofgem-price-cap-announcement-2026-11-25 LANE, 2026-09-09, FROM THE SAME OFGEM PRIMARY THAT NAMES ITS OWN DATE. Why this one earns a slot even though its sibling is LOW: it is the cap announcement where the UK electricity VAT story actually resolves. SI 2026/987 zero-rates domestic electricity in Great Britain from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027 (uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01, tracked; reversion tracked as uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01). The Jan-Mar 2027 cap therefore sits ENTIRELY inside the zero rate, which makes the Oct-to-Jan step VAT-clean. The Apr-Jun 2027 cap is the FIRST that must price electricity back at 5%, so this announcement carries a wholesale move AND a mechanical ~5% snap-back on the electricity leg in one number. Its consequence lands in the April 2027 CPI (~2027-05-19, already proposed by the reversion lane as uk-cpi-2027-05-19.from-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01) as an UPWARD base effect that is arithmetic, not re-acceleration. The attribution rule is the reason to track the announcement rather than only the print: a hot April 2027 UK electricity CPI reading is a tax reversal unless the 2026-10-28 Autumn Budget extended the zero rate, and Ofgem's own cap number on this date is where that shows up first. Tiered LOW on the same grounds as its sibling: symbols [], and this calendar's symbol universe is eight US mega-caps with no UK listing, utility, gilt or sterling instrument; no house playbook is energy- or sterling-keyed. Estimate widens caution only.
